Electric Assist Bicycle Options from R+E Cycles in Seattle
Rodriguez eBike Image Gallery
Electric Bikes - Rodriguez ePhinney
Our eBike customers want an eBike that's more 'bike' than'e'. They aren't looking for a 70 pound motorcycle, but rather an elegant, comfortably fit bicycle with a little help for their commute, or to keep up with their buddies! They want to feel like they are riding a bicycle.
• Ride comfortably - R+E Fitting Guaranteed
• Lighter weight than other eBike brands
• From a company with years experience
• We make it easy - customize any model
• No limits - Fat tire and skinny tire models
• Make short work of your commute
• Rest easy with R+E Cycles proven service
See options and specifications below
Commute, Save Gas $$, Ride for Fun with an The world of electric assist bicycles is evolving rapidly. Even so, most electric bikes are more like department store bikes with motors attached. Our customers want something different. They want a high quality bicycle that simply gave them assist. They want it to be light, responsive, and comfortably fit to their body measurements, just like we do for all of our bicycle customers at R+E Cycles. We're offering our classic Phinney Ridge in an eBike version. Just like like all Rodriguez bikes, it will fit just right. And, unlike other eBikes, all of our offerings here are light enough to ride as regular bikes, or lift onto your car rack.
Electric Bike Models @ R+E Cycles
How is R+E Cycles different from other companies offering eBikes?
Benefit from our experience of years building bicycles right here in Seattle's U-Distict
A focus on proper fit like no other company - Because your commuter bike should be your most comfortable bike
Fully custom and customizable parts and frame options - Have your eBike the way you want it
Get more power and longer run times for the $ with the U-District and Rodriguez models
Personal touch - Same great paint options as our Rodriguez bikes.
Why Just Buy an eBike...When You Can Buy the Whole eBike Shop!
